message: Your independent status-lines review 9e529ef0943d48eaae9a8fb435b3587e requested two P2 fixes; both are required before integration. Preserve all project aliases for @project filtering after canonical dedup, and stop accepting arbitrarily stale snapshots when concurrent aliases of one ledger fetch divergent heads. Prefer one verified fetch per logical ledger or compare ancestry with explicit inconsistency state. Add regressions for both findings and resubmit an exact frozen revision. This is still our top-priority UI feature; do not deploy or merge before acceptance.
